page_title: Writing Well Handbook by Julian Shapiro

summary.title: Writing Well Handbook by Julian Shapiro
summary.one_liner: A five-part online handbook that walks you through choosing a topic, drafting, rewriting, styling, and practicing nonfiction writing.
keywords: how to pick what to write about
takeaways: Pick a topic you want to write about and break it down before drafting.
Work through five stages: ideas, first drafts, rewriting for clarity, style and flow, then practice.
Writing publicly with an authentic voice can help you meet like-minded people.
Take notes while reading educational content to build connections between ideas.
summary.summary: This is the introduction page of a free online handbook by Julian Shapiro on writing nonfiction books and blogs. It explains why writing matters and who the handbook is for, then outlines five lessons: ideas, first drafts, rewriting, style, and practicing. The author says the handbook takes about thirty minutes and ends with a cheatsheet. The page itself gives no detailed writing techniques yet; those are on the later pages.
